caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile featuring a blue and white color scheme. The central portion of the textile displays a large symmetrical vase containing a bouquet of flowers with intricate foliage patterns extending outward. Flanking the vase on either side are two birds perched facing each other, and above them are ornamental motifs resembling stylized palm fronds or fern leaves. The lower portion of the textile is bordered by a row of simply rendered houses, each with windows and roofs forming a repeated panel pattern. The left vertical border of the textile is decorated with a similar series of house motifs oriented vertically, alongside a leafy or feathered ornament. The textile's edges are finished with a short, fringed trim. The overall composition is dense, with detailed and repetitive geometric and natural designs dominating the visually balanced layout. The background is predominantly blue, while the depicted objects, animals, plants, and buildings appear in white, creating a high-contrast effect. The drawing is set against a plain off-white background.
title: Blue and White Woolen Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
